name: Fairmont Windsor Park
insider_take: This brand-new luxury hotel sits on the historic Crown Estate, just minutes from Windsor Castle where royalty has resided for over 900 years.
whats_special: Fairmont Windsor Park opened in 2021 as the first new luxury hotel in Windsor in decades. The property occupies a stunning location within the 4,800-acre Windsor Great Park, offering direct views of the Long Walk—a tree-lined avenue that stretches 2.65 miles straight to Windsor Castle. The hotel's architecture pays homage to British heritage while incorporating contemporary luxury amenities.
pro_tip: Book a room facing north for unobstructed views of the Long Walk and Windsor Castle. The best photo opportunities are during golden hour when the castle is beautifully illuminated.
dont_miss: Take a morning stroll through Windsor Great Park to spot the famous red deer herd, visit the nearby Savill Garden with its stunning seasonal displays, or time your stay with the Changing of the Guard ceremony at Windsor Castle. The hotel's location also puts you within easy reach of Ascot Racecourse and the charming village of Eton.
pros: Prime location near Windsor Castle and Great Park
Luxurious Fairmont brand service and amenities
Easy access to London while enjoying countryside tranquility
Elegant accommodations with modern British design
